column1: # Golden set: curated modules (golden/select.tsv) + their import closure (role dep).
# tier ietf/netsnmp: text committed in golden/mibs/; ieee/vendor: reference only, the text is
# verified by sha256 (of the module text).
# expected: committed = expected oracle outputs in golden/expected/ (committed: the module and
# its import closure are ietf/netsnmp tier); local = golden/expected-local/ (not committed,
# derived from IEEE/vendor texts; golden.sh regenerates it from the corpus).
